description: This bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R (%) performance metric across three different LLaMA-2 model sizes—LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B—under varying conditions of SFT (Supervised Fine-Tuning) applied to different sets of data points, denoted as D₀, D₁, and D₂. The vertical axis represents the CoLeG-R (%) score, scaled linearly from 0 to 80 with major tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal axis lists the three model sizes in left-to-right order. For each model size, four bars are grouped together, each representing a different SFT configuration as defined in the legend: a light blue bar with diagonal stripes for “no SFT,” a solid orange bar for “+ SFT on D₀,” a light purple bar with diagonal stripes for “+ SFT on D₀, D₁,” and a solid pink bar for “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂.” The bars are not sorted by height; they are presented in the order of the model sizes. Visually, for each model, the performance increases with the addition of more SFT data points, with the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” configuration consistently yielding the highest scores. Specifically, for LLaMA-2-7B, the scores are approximately 67% (no SFT), 67% (+ SFT on D₀), 81% (+ SFT on D₀, D₁), and 83% (+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂). For LLaMA-2-13B, the scores are approximately 70% (no SFT), 73% (+ SFT on D₀), 84% (+ SFT on D₀, D₁), and 80% (+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂). For LLaMA-2-70B, the scores are approximately 81% (no SFT), 81% (+ SFT on D₀), 84% (+ SFT on D₀, D₁), and 83% (+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂). There is no visual emphasis such as shading or bolding on any particular bar.
